name: Ned
source:
Field of Study: Economics.

An intelligent young man with a bright future ahead, no doubt. However, he can be shy around people he doesn’t know well. You could probably get him to come out of his shell if you talk about his favorite Science Fiction Fantasy show “Time Wars.” For those who look past his shy exterior and nerdy personality to see him for the gem that he is, you’ll earn yourself a loyal friend, indeed.

[From [url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bound-to-college]official site[/url]]
